item.title: Introducing Iris: the swipe-to-apply AI job application app

item.title: How to write an ATS-friendly resume that applicant tracking systems can read
item.description: Make your resume readable by applicant tracking systems: use one column, standard headings, consistent dates, matching keywords and a text-based PDF or DOCX.
